title: Trench Arcane Deck Constraints Schema
description: Validates the ruleset parameters for deck construction in a given format.

main_deck_size_min.description: Minimum number of cards in the main deck (Units, Buildings, Commands).

main_deck_size_max.description: Maximum number of cards in the main deck.

resource_deck_size.description: Exact number of Resource cards required (e.g., exactly 6).

command_center_count.description: Exact number of Command Centers required (e.g., exactly 1).

max_copies_per_card.description: Maximum allowed copies of any single card by ID (e.g., 3).

allowed_resource_types.description: Optional. Restricts the deck to specific resource factions.
